name: Cloth Store
description: In the bustling Datang Street, there is a building full of girlish hearts - Buzhuang. There are many kinds of cloths here, and they are rich in colors. Many dignitaries like to buy clothes here. The overall appearance of the cloth shop is mainly pink, which is classic and dreamy. Silks of different colors are hung on the sides, fluttering in the wind, and very lively. Its details are exquisite, and the eaves, beams, and floors are covered with bright patterns, adding gorgeous style to the soft style.
